title: gbc: Generative Bayesian Computation
description:
Python package for Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC): Bayesian inference by training an Implicit Quantile Network on prior-predictive simulations, so posterior quantiles for an observed dataset come from a single forward pass rather than from a Markov chain.

Includes the extreme-value modules (GEV and generalized Pareto quantiles and return levels, maximum likelihood, non-stationary GEV, Hill, random-walk Metropolis, horseshoe spatial pooling, survivor-integral tail functionals) and MCMC convergence diagnostics, together with paper-wsc2026/, the complete reproduction bundle for Polson and Sokolov, Generative Bayesian Computation for Extreme Value Theory with Climate Applications, Winter Simulation Conference 2026: one driver per table, the derived station series, and the cluster scripts for the wall-clock benchmark and the training-budget sweep.
